reader_summary.overview: Adam Shapiro is the Managing Partner of East Rock Capital. Adam has recently begun sharing his insights on a LinkedIn newsletter entitled "From Star to Founder." Our conversation covers Adam's background, his investment objectives for families. We discuss East Rock's assessment of managers, portfolio construction, and risk management from their carefully selected set of ideas.
